failure_cases.name: New scams it has never seen
failure_cases.measured: 97% of the red team's 1624 payments from 50 invented scams were not interrupted
failure_cases.why: they avoid the signals RUKO weighs most: the call ends long before the payment, the first payment is small and genuine-looking, the payee is not yet known as a mule
failure_cases.fix: the blue team groups the 1930 complaints these scams cause, drafts a playbook, two analysts approve it; cross-user signals (same UPI ID in many scam messages, new account paid by many) catch the money end without knowing the script

failure_cases.name: Scam messages in Hindi
failure_cases.measured: 73% of Hindi scam messages caught vs 85% overall; 6.8% of normal Hindi messages flagged
failure_cases.why: fewer Hindi training templates, and Devanagari word forms vary more
failure_cases.fix: more Hindi templates in the lure corpus; never let a message alone interrupt (it never does: rule 5)

failure_cases.name: A call over WhatsApp or another app
failure_cases.measured: not measured on the simulator (it only has phone-network calls)
failure_cases.why: the phone sees that a VoIP call is on, not who is calling, so 'unknown caller' and the fraud-list check of the number are unknown (rule 1: unknown is never treated as safe)
failure_cases.fix: a VoIP call during a payment already counts for the call signal; add the chat app's contact check

failure_cases.name: Many small payments over days
failure_cases.measured: salami and anchor patterns were added after the audit (R7); not yet re-measured on a held-out world
failure_cases.why: each payment alone looks ordinary and stays under the amount caps
failure_cases.fix: 24-hour outflow to new payees against the user's usual maximum (in the engine now)

failure_cases.name: The weakest known scam type: task job
failure_cases.measured: 92% of its payments interrupted on the held-out world
failure_cases.why: see 'Scams it missed' for what those payments had in common
failure_cases.fix: retrain with the new cross-user features (ML owner)

failure_cases.name: The simulated world is too easy
failure_cases.measured: mule account age alone separates mules almost perfectly (data/eval/realism/FINDINGS.md)
failure_cases.why: so the payment numbers mostly show that the pipeline works end to end; real numbers will be lower
failure_cases.fix: a more realistic simulator; then retrain and re-measure with the same commands
